nodes.label: Lexer
nodes.desc: Tokenizes template source: tags, attributes, entities and raw text blocks.

nodes.label: HtmlParser
nodes.desc: Recursive-descent Parser subclass tuned for Angular template HTML and its void/optional tags.

nodes.label: parseTemplate()
nodes.desc: Entry point that parses a template and reports errors, interpolation counts and used pipes.

nodes.label: htmlAstToRender3Ast()
nodes.desc: Rewrites the HTML AST into an R3 AST: bound properties, events, variables, @if/@for/@defer blocks.

nodes.label: R3TargetBinder
nodes.desc: Resolves which directives/pipes match each template node and tracks variable scoping.

nodes.label: NgtscProgram
nodes.desc: Implements api.Program: plugs Angular analysis into a TypeScript compiler host.

nodes.label: NgCompiler
nodes.desc: Coordinates analysis, resolution, template type checking and emit for the whole program.

nodes.label: compileComponentFromMetadata()
nodes.desc: Generates the component partial declaration: host bindings, features, template function.

nodes.label: compileDirectiveFromMetadata()
nodes.desc: Same codegen path for directives: selector, inputs, outputs and host binding instructions.

nodes.label: compileInjector()
nodes.desc: Emits ɵɵdefineInjector for standalone components and NgModules.

nodes.label: compileNgModule()
nodes.desc: Emits ɵɵdefineNgModule: declared directives/pipes, imports, exports and provider arrays.

nodes.label: compilePipe()
nodes.desc: Emits ɵɵdefinePipe with the transform function reference and pipe flags.

nodes.label: ɵɵdefineComponent
nodes.desc: Accepts the partial declaration, sets defaults and freezes the component definition.

nodes.label: compileDirective (JIT)
nodes.desc: Runtime counterpart that links partial declarations when there is no AOT build.

nodes.label: R3Injector
nodes.desc: Environment injector: processes providers, caches instances, resolves injector initializers.

nodes.label: createInjector()
nodes.desc: Builds an R3Injector from an injector type plus optional providers, then runs initializers.

nodes.label: inject()
nodes.desc: Public injection API: reads the current injection context and forwards token + flags.

nodes.label: NodeInjector
nodes.desc: Per-element injector: follows parent/sibling links up the DOM tree, then the environment injector.

nodes.label: ɵɵdirectiveInject
nodes.desc: Instruction emitted for inject(): resolves through NodeInjector, then R3Injector.

nodes.label: ɵɵtemplate
nodes.desc: Declares an embedded view (e.g. @for body) and instantiates its matching directive.

nodes.label: ɵɵadvance
nodes.desc: Moves the current index so later update instructions target the right node.

nodes.label: ɵɵproperty
nodes.desc: Binds a property/directive input on the current node during the update block.

nodes.label: ComponentRef
nodes.desc: Handle to a live component: setInput() writes inputs and marks the host view dirty.

nodes.label: detectChangesInternal()
nodes.desc: Global or component-scoped check entry: walks the view tree in while-dirty mode.

nodes.label: refreshView()
nodes.desc: Refreshes one LView: embedded views, child components, then the update instructions.

nodes.label: markViewDirty()
nodes.desc: Marks the view and its ancestors dirty, then hands off to the scheduler.

nodes.label: ChangeDetectionSchedulerImpl
nodes.desc: Zoneless implementation: coalesces notifications and notifies ApplicationRef via notify().

nodes.label: signal()
nodes.desc: Creates a writable signal; producers notify consumers that read them during change detection.

nodes.label: computed()
nodes.desc: Lazily recomputed derived signal that tracks its producer dependencies.

nodes.label: effect()
nodes.desc: Reactive side effect that reruns when tracked signals change, flushed by the scheduler.

nodes.label: internalCreateApplication()
nodes.desc: Shared bootstrap core: creates the root environment injector and the ApplicationRef.

nodes.label: ApplicationRef
nodes.desc: Attaches views, subscribes to the scheduler and runs tick() for global refreshes.

nodes.label: DomRendererFactory2
nodes.desc: Creates Renderers that apply styles, attributes and DOM mutations per encapsulation mode.
